title: SOC2 evidence daily scratchpad
content:
Daily scratchpad - SOC2 evidence + vendor reviews (personal notes)

Date: 2026-03-03
Owner: Morgan Evans
Context: quick running log of what I need to collect/verify for control evidence this week. Informal notes - will move finalized artifacts to Confluence and attach to JIRA.

Top priorities (today)
- [ ] Finalize access-review evidence for IAM provisioning (control: user access reviews) - pull last quarter review export from Okta, scrub demo/test accounts. (target: EOD 2026-03-03)
- [ ] Upload signed vendor DPA for Pinecloud Analytics (pending legal) and link to vendor inventory. Status: waiting on legal signature email (follow-up with Priya).
- [ ] Validate change-approval logs for release pipeline (control: change management) - need git commit SHAs + approval screenshots for 2026-02-10 -> 2026-03-02 window.

Notes / evidence mapping
- IAM access reviews: Okta export -> saved as okta-access-export-2026-q1.csv (TODO: scrub and upload). Link in Confluence page: CONFLUENCE-SEC-SOC2-EVIDENCE#okta
- User onboarding/offboarding: HR sends termination list monthly. Need last termination report (Feb) from People Ops, ask Noah if already uploaded.
- Change management: CircleCI -> approval audit in PRs. For each PR include reviewer + approval timestamp. Might need to attach screenshots for web approvals where API audit is missing.
- Logical access to production: Collect ephemeral key rotation logs (KMS) for service accounts used by infra CI. Contact infra on KMS rotation runbook.

Vendor reviews (quick)
- Pinecloud Analytics (analytics provider): Vendor questionnaire mostly complete. Missing: signed DPA, SOC2 report copy. Action: Priya to chase legal for DPA; request SOC2 report directly from vendor security contact (amy@pinecloud).
- StoreSafe (backup vendor): Have DPA and SOC2 Type II 2025. Need evidence of last penetration test summary (vendor says available on request). Put request in thread: VendorReview-StoreSafe-2026-02-28.
- Sentry-like monitoring: internal eval - currently using self-hosted; mark as low risk for this scope but document config and retention periods (30d logs).

Policy TODOs / gaps
- Data retention policy (draft) still missing specific retention for dev logs. Add 30/90/365 buckets and owners. Owner: Morgan (draft by 2026-03-07).
- Remote access policy: need to confirm MFA enforcement for all admin roles (Okta policy screenshot + org policy doc).
- Encrypt-at-rest note: verify backup vendor encryption algorithm and KMS key owner mapping.

Meeting notes / quick comms
- 2026-03-02 sync w/ Priya: Priya to push legal follow-up for Pinecloud DPA. She will also upload SOC2 evidence index spreadsheet (link expected by 2026-03-04).
- 2026-03-03 standup: flagged missing change-approval screenshots. Action: Morgan to collect and attach to JIRA-SEC-4123.

Quick checklist for evidence collection (short)
- [ ] Okta export scrubbed + uploaded to Confluence
- [ ] DPA signed for Pinecloud attached to vendor inventory
- [ ] Change management: PR approvals attached for sample window
- [ ] KMS rotation logs exported for service accounts
- [ ] Vendor SOC2 reports saved (Pinecloud, StoreSafe)
- [ ] Data retention policy draft ready for review

Random notes / troubleshooting
- If Okta export includes test accounts with @redwood-internal, filter by email domain and account created date.
- For screenshots, use naming convention: controlname_evidence_<YYYYMMDD>_<short>.png

Next actions (tomorrow)
- Morning: follow up with Priya on Pinecloud DPA (Slack + email).
- Midday: pull CircleCI/PR approvals and start attaching to JIRA sample.
- Afternoon: draft data retention policy section for dev logs.

Local todo (personal)
- Reconcile my evidence index spreadsheet with Confluence index (might duplicate entries)
- Clean up old scratch files in Drive (temp evidence exports) to avoid confusion during final upload

End of scratchpad. Will tidy and publish to Confluence when samples validated.
